standard.name: FAIR Genomes metadata schema (FAIR Genomes semantic model)
standard.abstract: FAIR Genomes defines a semantic metadata schema to describe next-generation sequencing (NGS) data and associated clinical, sample and consent information to enable Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability and Reusability (FAIR) of genomic data in Dutch healthcare and research. The schema groups metadata into modules (Study, Personal, Leaflet and consent form, Individual consent, Clinical, Material, Sample preparation, Sequencing and Analysis) and is represented as a YAML file that can be transformed into machine-readable formats (JSON, RDF) and templates for data-entry systems.

classification.rationale: The FAIR Genomes output is a semantic metadata schema with modules and defined elements/value types (a structured table of metadata fields and lookups), so 'table' best represents the standard format.
